subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

In India, as perhaps in many other countries of the world, trees have been held in veneration since ______ times.
solution:
The correct answer is **"ancient."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'ancient'** means belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence. (प्राचीन, पुरातन, हज़ारों वर्ष पुराना)

 
 
• **Example:** *This is an **ancient**__ civilization.*
 
 
 
• The sentence talks about how trees have been held in high regard since ancient times, meaning since a long time ago.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence:** *In India, as perhaps in many other countries of the world, trees have been held in veneration since __**ancient**__ times. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Vintage** means relating to a high quality or period of time in the past, usually referring to wine or clothing.
 
• **Antique** means old and valuable, usually referring to a piece of furniture or other object.
 
• **Retro** means imitative of a style or fashion from the recent past.
